What is Ideogram?

Image generator distinguished by its ability to render legible, accurately spelled text inside images - the hardest problem for diffusion models - making it the practical choice for logos, posters, signage and typographic design.

Best for

Any image that must contain readable, correctly spelled text.

Main features

  • Best-in-class in-image text rendering
  • Magic Prompt automatic prompt enhancement
  • Canvas editor with inpainting, outpainting and extend
  • Describe (image-to-prompt)
  • style references and character consistency
  • batch generation
  • private generation on paid tiers
  • Ideogram 3.0 model with improved photorealism.

Practical use cases

  • Generating a poster or flyer with correct headline text
  • logo and wordmark concepts
  • social media graphics with captions baked in
  • T-shirt and merchandise designs
  • signage mockups
  • typographic art.

Who is it for?

  • Graphic designers, marketers, social media managers, small business owners creating their own visual assets.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium credit-based subscription

Plans described in the source

Free with a limited daily credit allowance and public generations. Basic around $8/mo ($7 annually) with priority credits and private generation. Plus around $20/mo ($16 annually) with substantially more credits. Pro around $60/mo ($48 annually) for high volume and API access. Annual billing roughly 20% cheaper.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with daily credits, but generations are publicly visible in the community feed.

Free trial

The free tier serves as the trial.

Usage limits to consider

Credit-metered with separate priority and slow credit pools - slow credits queue behind priority users. Free tier generations are public by default. Private generation requires a paid tier.

Confirm current plans and pricing ↗

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Text rendering is genuinely a category ahead of Midjourney and most competitors - this alone justifies it for design work involving words
  • very cheap entry price
  • Magic Prompt helps non-expert users get good results
  • Canvas editor gives real compositional control.

Limitations to consider

  • Overall aesthetic quality trails Midjourney for purely artistic work
  • free tier generations are public, which rules it out for client work
  • Arabic and non-Latin script rendering in images remains poor
  • smaller company with less certainty than Adobe or OpenAI
  • credit queue on slow credits can be frustrating.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android

Languages

  • Prompts in English work best; in-image text rendering is strongest for Latin scripts and unreliable for Arabic

API access

Yes - Ideogram API available on Pro tier and above, priced per generation

Integrations and exports

  • API
  • no major native app integrations

Evaluation notes

Verify in-image text in your target script before committing - the text advantage is largely a Latin-script advantage. The public-by-default free tier is a genuine confidentiality issue for agency work.
